summary: B15: the bridge loads content/factions/ and hands the registry to the simulation, so Godot and the Rust harness run the same island; S5's registry seam closes

coordination.notes: Three lanes share godot-rust/src/expedition.rs and two share strategy/tick.rs. B15 changes exactly one signature in expedition.rs (resolve_midnight_in) plus its callers, and touches only the body of run_hour in tick.rs; the ExpeditionState struct tail, strategic_tick's body and StrategicEvent's variant list are left alone for S6/S7. utility.rs is not touched (S6 owns it).
